description: A partial function \(f:\mathbb N^2\rightharpoonup\mathbb N\) is partial recursive under the finite-vector closure rules if and only if its curried form \((x,y)\mapsto f(x,y)\) satisfies the binary library predicate \(\operatorname{Partrec}_2\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.RecursiveFunctionConventions.binary_recursive_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ} :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v =>
      f (List.Vector.get v 0) (List.Vector.get v 1)) ↔
    Partrec₂ f
